description: One station’s exact CEC identity, official published building point/address, aggregate result and independent census assignment; historical positions are not inferred.

ballot_label.description: Exact published ballot-box label, including decimal or suffix when present, from search_polling_stations; for example 50.

election_id.description: latest, a Knesset ID such as k26, or full YYYY-MM-DD date. A bare 2019 is ambiguous.

locality_code.description: Official CBS locality code of the station, for example 4000 for Haifa.

name: get_polling_station
